SEGCOM Exported Functions

group SEGCOM_Exported_Functions

Functions

void SEGCOM_CLK_Config(FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable SEGCOM clock.

Example usage 

void driver_segcom_init(void)
{
    SEGCOM_CLK_Config(ENABLE);
}

参数:

NewState -- [in] New state of SEGCOM clock. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • ENABLE: Enable SEGCOM clock.

  • DISABLE: Disable SEGCOM clock.

void SEGCOM_Cmd(FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable SEGCOM.

Example usage 

void driver_segcom_init(void)
{
    SEGCOM_Cmd(ENABLE);
}

参数:

NewState -- [in] New state of SEGCOM. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • ENABLE: Enable SEGCOM.

  • DISABLE: Disable SEGCOM.

void SEGCOM_StructInit(SEGCOM_InitTypeDef *SEGCOM_InitStruct)

Fill configuration structure with default value.

Parameter

Default Value

SEG_bias

BIAS_STATIC

SEG_duty

DUTY_STATIC

SEG_blink_mode

BLINK_DISABLE

SEG_blink_freq_div

BLINK_FREQ_DIV_8

SEG_dead_time

DEAD_TIME_NONE

SEG_driv_ctl_mode

SEGCOM_AUTO_MODE

SEG_high_driv_duration

HIGH_DURATION_0

SEG_clk_divider

CLK_DIV_16

SEG_clk_prescaler

CLK_PRESCALE_1

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    SEGCOM_InitTypeDef init_struct;
    SEGCOM_StructInit(&init_struct);
}

参数:

SEGCOM_InitStruct -- [in] Pointer to configuration structure to be initialized.

void SEGCOM_IntConfig(SEGCOM_INTERRUPT Interrupt, FunctionalState NewState)

Configure specified interrupt.

Example usage 

void driver_segcom_init(void)
{
    SEGCOM_IntConfig(SEGCOM_UPDATE_DISPLAY_DONE_INT, ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • interrupt -- [in] Specified interrupt type. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • SEGCOM_UPDATE_DISPLAY_DONE_INT: Update display done interrupt.

    • SEGCOM_START_OF_FRAME_INT: Start of frame interrupt.

  • NewState -- [in] Specified interrupt type.

    • ENABLE: Enable interrupt.

    • DISABLE: Disable interrupt.

ITStatus SEGCOM_GetStatus(SEGCOM_STATUS Flag)

Get SEGCOM status.

Example usage 

void driver_segcom_init(void)
{
    uint32_t status = SEGCOM_GetStatus(SEGCOM_STATUS_LCD_ENABLE);
    if(status)
    {
        //User operation
    }
}

参数:

Flag -- [in] Specified status type. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • SEGCOM_STATUS_LCD_ENABLE: LCD enable status.

  • SEGCOM_STATUS_START_OF_FRAME: Start of frame.

  • SEGCOM_STATUS_UPDATE_DISP_REQ: Update display request.

  • SEGCOM_STATUS_UPDATE_DISP_DONE: Update display done.

  • SEGCOM_STATUS_FRAME_CTL_REG_SYNC: Frame control synchronize.

返回值:

  • SET -- Event has occured.

  • RESET -- No such event occured.

返回:

Current event status

void SEGCOM_ClearStatus(SEGCOM_CLEAR_STATUS Status)

Clear SEGCOM status.

Example usage 

void driver_segcom_init(void)
{
    SEGCOM_ClearStatus(SEGCOM_CLEAR_START_OF_FRAME);
}

参数:

Status -- [in] Specified status type. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • SEGCOM_CLEAR_START_OF_FRAME: Clear start of frame status.

  • SEGCOM_CLEAR_UPDATE_DISPLAY_DONE: Clear update display done status.

void SEGCOM_Write(SEGCOM_COM_NUM Channel, uint32_t Value)

Write value to specified COM.

Example usage 

void driver_segcom_init(void)
{
    SEGCOM_Write(SEGCOM_RAM_COM0, 0xF0F0F0F0);
}

参数:

  • Channel -- [in] Specified COM number. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • SEGCOM_RAM_COM0: SEGCOM data register for COM0.

    • SEGCOM_RAM_COM1: SEGCOM data register for COM1.

    • SEGCOM_RAM_COM2: SEGCOM data register for COM2.

    • SEGCOM_RAM_COM3: SEGCOM data register for COM3.

  • Value -- [in] Value to be written.

void SEGCOM_UpdateDisplayRequest(void)

Send update display request.

Example usage 

void driver_segcom_init(void)

    SEGCOM_UpdateDisplayRequest();
}

void SEGCOM_Init(SEGCOM_InitTypeDef *SEGCOM_InitStruct)

Use the configuration from input parameter to initilize SEGCOM.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_init(void)
{
    SEGCOM_InitTypeDef init_struct;
    SEGCOM_StructInit(&init_struct);
    SEGCOM_Init(&init_struct);
}

参数:

SEGCOM_InitStruct -- [in] Pointer to configuration structure.

Send update clock request.

Example usage 

void driver_segcom_init(void)
{
    SEGCOM_Update_Clk();
}

void SEGCOM_Pin_Init(SEGCOM_COM_Pin_CFG_Typedef com_cfg, SEGCOM_SEG_Pin_CFG_Typedef seg_cfg)

Determine which pins to be used as SEGs and COMs.

Example usage 

void driver_segcom_init(void)
{
    SEGCOM_COM_Pin_CFG_Typedef coms = {0};
    SEGCOM_SEG_Pin_CFG_Typedef segs = {0};

    coms.com0_p_0_2 = 1;
    segs.seg17_p_4_3 = 1;

    SEGCOM_Pin_Init(coms, segs);
}

参数:

  • com_cfg -- [in] Determine COM pins configuration.

  • seg_cfg -- [in] Determine SEG pins configuration.
